One bounded activity per exercise holds: one include-link, two `## Phase N` headings inside it, no sub-numbered exercises. §12's split question was considered seriously and declined on the rule's own counter-clause — the phases chain (Phase 1's dominant gap feeds the sidestep's primitive ranking; Phase 2's shapes feed the close's handoff prompt) and both already carry their own failure rows, decision points and timings.
